info.name: Orwickle API
info.description:
Orwickle backend (Node.js + Express) up to week 8: auth, profiles and verification documents, listings, and the admin API.

Run the numbered folders 00-06 in order with the Collection Runner (they log in with the demo accounts from `npm run seed:demo` and carry the tokens along). Folder 99 holds requests you send by hand.
Set the collection variable `adminPassword` first.

exec: pm.test('server and database are up', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.database).to.eql('connected'); });

item.name: 01 Login (demo accounts, no OTP needed)

exec: pm.test('returns an access token and the owner role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('owner'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the owner role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('owner'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the investor role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('investor'); });
pm.test('returns an access token and the admin role', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('admin'); });

item.name: Login with a wrong password is refused

item.description: Run `npm run seed:demo` in backend/ first. Set the collection variable adminPassword. At most 10 logins per 15 minutes are allowed from one address (this folder uses 5).

item.name: An investor cannot see a draft
Owner publishes: it waits for admin review
Published but unapproved is still hidden from investors
Admin sees it in the review queue

exec: pm.test('admin sees the confidential details', () => pm.expect(body.listings.find(x => x.listing.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('listingId')).confidential.fullDescription).to.include('POSTMAN-SECRET'));
pm.test('field error on reason', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details['reason']).to.eql("Give a reason so the user knows what to change"));

request.description: Sends an approval email to the owner (for the demo owner this goes to a non-existent @demo.orwickle.app address, which is harmless).

item.name: Search users by role and name

exec: pm.test('only investors, never admins', () => pm.expect(body.users.every(u => u.role === 'investor')).to.be.true);

item.name: One user with profile, documents and decisions

exec: pm.test('profile, documents and history are included', () => { pm.expect(body.profile.role).to.eql('investor'); pm.expect(body.profile.documents).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.decisions).to.be.an('array'); });
